identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit: 'Heritage Schools Inc', Provo, UT, EIN 87-0514958 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda location 'Provo, UT'

California Department of Education School Directory lists 'Heritage Schools, Inc.' at 5600 North Heritage School Dr., Provo, UT as an out-of-state Nonpublic Certified School, matching OUSD's 'Nonpublic, Nonsectarian School' special education master contract
The CDE directory lists website www.heritagertc.org, and that site (The Heritage Community) describes residential treatment academies for teens at the same Provo address
research.notes: Operates publicly as 'The Heritage Community'. The website lists a main phone of 800-433-9413 and no general email; the phone given is the number in the CDE directory. No California entity number or SAM UEI looked up.

profile.address: 5600 North Heritage School Dr., Provo, UT 84604
profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Provo, Utah that runs residential treatment programs for teenagers, operating as the Heritage Community. Its academies offer mental health treatment, including programs for neurodiverse youth. It is certified as a nonpublic school in California's school directory.
